name: com.hungnt.core
description: Core utilities for the HungNT base code: DebugEx logging, MonoSingleton, general extensions, and IAppLifecycle (Unity lifecycle messages as C# events, so services can be plain C# classes). Ships a VContainer installer (`builder.InstallCore()`). Requires VContainer (jp.hadashikick.vcontainer). Editor tools: scene window, package catalog manager, data menu — requires Odin Inspector in the project.
